description: Install a source-safe factual-mass-weighted query repair for A191.

extra.target: Original HOST minus original parent normalized-query causal scores at exact parent inputs and fixed original query raw RMS
extra.basis_construction: One original-response canonical input covariance and one original-response PCA output covariance per head, training only
extra.metric: Convex combination of separately centered uniform-causal and factual-mass losses; each uses its own exact recorded-key Gram at fixed original normalization; actual rounded query RMS checked
extra.selection: Each head minimizes validation factual-mass centered MSE among source-safe candidates without worsening original uniform MSE; combined factual-mass MSE must improve10percent versus parent and5percent versus selected A237
extra.scope_limit: Factual attention mixture coefficients are recovered by a unique linear inverse. No new attention probabilities are evaluated; no native output trajectory or final prediction gain is claimed; official score required
